profile.headline: Software Engineer at Pindrop
profile.summary:
Software Engineer | Recent experienced with AWS, Google Cloud, Golang, Docker, ArgoCD, and Grafana | Love piano, badminton and Overcooked game | Ultimate goal is financial independence
🏆2nd Place in CodeRED Voyage 2020 Hackathon with https://devpost.com/software/college-buddy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build a tool to scan and report vulnerabilities on AWS EC2 AMIs through Lacework
• Perform and fine-tune OS upgrade process for PCI (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance
• Optimize storage usage cost on both AWS and GCP platforms using lifecycle rules
• Develop features to merge multiple calls for customers
• Resolve more than 30 time-sensitive bugs ranging from internal tools to customer-facing issues
• Migrate metrics graphs and alerts from Datadog to Grafana 
• Host training meetings with team members to guide and answer questions related to projects that I owned

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build new features and maintain web application that monitors pipeline and telecom infrastructure projects.

• Develop features to track and log activities' progress over 900 pipeline infrastructure projects
• Resolve more than 20 time-sensitive bugs and clients' issues through GitLab ticket system
• Work on AWS Cognito APIs
• Build a web tool for Customer Support team to add and maintain licenses for clients
• Redesign web application front-end using Bootstrap and Figma
• Collaborate with team memebers and management through SCRUM method
• Participate in training meetings with clients and answer technical-related questions on company software products
• Report clients' feedbacks from user experience perspective and provide approach to them with team members

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Improve web app security and user experience on web application

• Prevent SQL injection for all queries on server side code in VB .NET
• Build date range filter for infrastructure projects' reports and charts using Chart JS

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Tutored over 100 students with C++ concepts
• Wrote coding assignments and test cases
• Grade and leave feedbacks on students' codes
• Meet and discuss students' concerns with professors and other teaching assistants
• Provide additional, free resources on C++ for students in need

positions.title: Front End Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Work on main website front-end from wireframes: https://www.superworldapp.com/

• Translate multiple page folds design in Adobe XD into front-end code on the main website using ReactJS
• Maintain website responsiveness through breakpoints for multiple devices’ display
• Document and plan work with team members on Trello

courses.name: Full Stack Web Developement @ The Odin Project

honors.title: 2nd Place in CodeRED Voyage Hackathon
honors.description:
College Buddy web application provides a minimalist and straightforward solution to triaging the internet for free pdf copies of college textbook. It scouts the internet to find the safe and most secure PDFs for the book students are looking for. Also it has a list with 200+ discount options in different categories.

My role for this project:
• Design webpage using Adobe XD
• Create web page front-end using ReactJS
• Acquire and displayed digital textbooks through an Python Flask API
honors.issuer: Issued by CodeRED Voyage Hackathon 2020 · Nov 2020
